name: Sony PTZ cameras (HTTP/CGI: BRC-AM7, SRG-A40, SRG-A12, ILME-FR7)
notes: Complete list: 39 actions (src/actions/*.ts, one function per group, all returned as object literals and merged in src/actions/index.ts) and 19 boolean feedbacks (src/feedbacks.ts, single setFeedbackDefinitions call). No definitions are generated at runtime. The module registers every action for every camera; it has no model selection (the manifest lists BRC-AM7, SRG-A40, SRG-A12 and ILME-FR7).

Protocol: HTTP GET with digest authentication to the camera (default port 80; src/config.ts, src/api/transport.ts). Commands go to command/ptzf.cgi and other CGI paths, status inquiries to command/inquiry.cgi. Configuration: Target IP, Target Port, User, Password, Referer header (default on), Status Check (default on) and Status Check Interval (default 10000 ms, 500 to 3600000). Variables and presets are not catalogued.

Dropdown ids are strings with prefixes (for example preset_3, preset_set_3, multitrackingnum_2, waittime_15, scenefile_set_4); the action callbacks parse them with String.replace. Feedback dropdown ids are different strings (for example the sceneFile feedback uses "0" to "16", shotMode uses the numeric strings "1200", "510", "310", "200").

Many numeric fields are text inputs with useVariables and a default string; the value is resolved with resolveNumber (rounded, falls back to the default when not numeric) and the hint in the label (for example "Speed (0-24)") describes the range the module clamps to. The catalog records no min/max for those text inputs because the source has no such field attribute.

Absolute focus/zoom/PTZF/pan-tilt and relative pan-tilt actions pass the text values unchanged to the camera CGI (AbsoluteFocus, AbsoluteZoom, AbsolutePTZF, AbsolutePanTilt, RelativePanTilt), and the module does not validate them. The own position code of the module converts to 4-character hex strings for the camera (src/api/camera-api.ts:38), but these raw actions document no format. other_command_action and generic_step_action send arbitrary CGI paths and parameters (params is a "key=value&key=value" string).
ptz_step_action does nothing when the focusPos variable is empty (no status polled yet). generic_step_action keeps its value in the variable named after the parameter with a lower-case first letter.

Option fields isVisibleExpression ($(options:val) == ...) are recorded as visibleWhen. These expressions are evaluated by Companion in the UI only; the option values themselves do not support expressions because the module is built on @companion-module/base ~1.14.1 (1.x, no expression support).
Extracted statically (parsed with the TypeScript compiler API, constants and Array.from spreads resolved, no code executed). Not tested against a camera or a running Companion instance.
